summary: All 37 order-only watch-order entries were resolved against AniList's `format` field (GraphQL Media query, id or search) and, where a page exists, en-Wikipedia's animanga video infobox / lead sentence. 34 of the 37 map cleanly onto the T29 vocabulary (ova | special | movie | recap) and are delivered in structure.order_only: 20 ova, 6 special, 8 movie, 0 recap. THREE entries could not be cited as any of the four kinds and are in flags_for_sean rather than guessed: cells-at-work @11.5 (both AniList and en-WP call the Pocari Sweat collab an ONA), high-school-dxd @36.5 (AniList counts 'Holy Behind the Gymnasium' inside the TV run of HERO — 13 eps from 2018-04-10 — and en-WP lists it as season episode 0 / overall 41 in the TV episode table; ja-WP numbers it life.00), and the-heroic-legend-of-arslan @25.2 (AniList 21424 format=TV, 8 eps — this is the missing season-2 component, not an order-only bonus, exactly as the stored note says). Four entries look like TWO pairs of duplicates (to-love-ru-darkness @24.1 vs @24.5, and yu-yu-hakusho-ghostfiles @112.1 vs @112.5) — each pair resolves to a single AniList work; both members are typed here, and the duplication is flagged for Sean. yu-yu-hakusho @112.7 and @112.8 are NOT duplicates (two distinct 2018 shorts) but share one AniList id, 102631, because AniList bundles them as a single entry. Four entries carry a source disagreement on the kind (GITS Solid State Society, Ippo Champion Road, Reborn @203.1, YYH @112.7/.8) — each is typed to the source that does not contradict stored data, with the disagreement flagged.

structure.notes:
METHOD (R3, R20). Every kind below is cited from a queried AniList `format` field and/or an en-Wikipedia statement — never from the entry's title. AniList was queried live via https://graphql.anilist.co (Media(id:){format episodes duration startDate endDate}); ids not present in our components were found by Media(search:) and confirmed by matching the entry's stated air date to the AniList startDate/endDate, never by index or by title similarity alone.

DATE CONFIRMATIONS (the ask's 'a kind may be derivable from an order-only component whose AniList start date equals the entry's air date'): black-butler @46.75 2014-11-15 = AniList 20670 endDate (Book of Murder is a 2-episode OVA, 2014-10-25 / 2014-11-15, so the stored entry is its Part 2); bungo-stray-dogs @24.5 2017-08-04 = AniList 21791 startDate; seraph @24.5 2016-05-02 = AniList 21586 startDate; golden-kamuy @49.3 2025-10-17 = AniList 194872 startDate; golden-kamuy @49.4 2025-10-10 = AniList 196115 startDate (前編; 後編 2025-10-31); my-hero-academia @113.1 2021-08-06 = AniList 126659 startDate; cells-at-work @11.5 2019-07-08 = AniList 138675 startDate; high-school-dxd @36.5 2018-04-10 = AniList 97767 (HERO) startDate — i.e. Episode 0 IS the season's first broadcast, which is why AniList counts HERO at 13 episodes while our component spans 12 rows (37-48).

TIE-BREAK POLICY where AniList and Wikipedia disagree, stated once so the choices are auditable: (1) never contradict stored data (a stored component kind or a stored ruling); (2) otherwise prefer the classification that matches how the work was actually distributed — a home-video/box-set bundle is `ova`, a one-off broadcast or event screening is `special`, a theatrical release is `movie`; (3) flag the disagreement either way. Applied: GITS @52.5 -> special (AniList SPECIAL + our stored component kind [special] for id 1566; en-WP says 'television film' and Sean's order-only rationale invoked the movies rule); hajime-no-ippo @76.6 -> special (AniList SPECIAL + stored component kind [special] for id 264; en-WP infobox says type=tv film); reborn @203.1 -> ova (en-WP states 'An original video animation (OVA) ... released in October 2009 during the annual Jump Super Anime Tour' and 'List of Reborn! episodes' has an == OVAs == table; AniList 8532 says ONA; no stored component exists to contradict); yu-yu-hakusho @112.7/@112.8 -> ova (en-WP infobox type=ova, 'Two Shot & All or Nothing', 2 episodes, 2018-10-26, bundled with a Blu-ray box; AniList 102631 says SPECIAL).

ANILIST ID NOTES. reborn @203.1 = AniList 8532 — the stored note said 'AniList id not verified'; it is now verified by native title (家庭教師ヒットマンREBORN! ボンゴレファミリー総登場! ボンゴレ式修学旅行、来る!!) and by ja-WP's ジャンプアニメ section describing the same Jump Super Anime Tour 2009 screening plus the 2010-07-21 complete-edition DVD. yu-yu-hakusho @112.7 and @112.8 SHARE AniList id 102631 (one AniList entry, 'Yuu☆Yuu☆Hakusho: TWO SHOTS / Noru ka Soru ka', eps=1, 29 min) covering both shorts — the id is not per-entry and must not be used as a uniqueness key. cardcaptor-sakura's two films are AniList 371 (1999-08-21) and 372 (2000-07-15). my-hero-academia @113.1 is AniList 126659, NOT 142411 ('Tabidachi', a separate 6-minute short).

KIND TALLY of the 34 delivered: ova = black-butler @46.75, bungo @24.5, fate-kaleid @10.5, golden-kamuy @12.1 / @24.2 / @49.3, hajime-no-ippo @76.3, dragon-maid @13.5, prison-school @12.5, reborn @203.1, kenshin @94.1 / @94.2 / @94.4, seraph @24.5, slime @24.1, magus-bride @24.1, arslan @25.1, to-love-ru-darkness @12.2, yyh @112.7 / @112.8 (20). special = GITS @52.5, hajime-no-ippo @76.6, to-love-ru-darkness @24.1 / @24.5, yyh @112.1 / @112.5 (6). movie = cardcaptor @35.1 / @70.1, golden-kamuy @49.4, my-hero-academia @113.1, kenshin @94.3, slime @48.2 / @72.3, yu-gi-oh-2000 @224.5 (8). recap = none: no entry in this set is a recap, and none was assigned one to fill the vocabulary.

flags_for_sean:
UNCITABLE KIND (1 of 3) — cells-at-work @11.5 'Heat Stress: If There Was Pocari Sweat' (2019-07-08): BOTH sources call it an ONA, which is not a T29 kind. AniList 138675 'Pocari Sweat web movie: Hataraku Saibou Dai 11.5-wa Necchuushou - Moshimo Pocari Sweat ga Attara' format=ONA, 10 min, 2019-07-08 (https://anilist.co/anime/138675); en-WP 'List of Cells at Work! episodes' lists it as 'EpisodeNumber = 11.5
(ONA)' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Cells_at_Work!_episodes). Not guessed. If you want it typed inside the current vocabulary, `special` is the nearest fit (a promotional bonus short outside the broadcast run); the alternative is adding `ona` to the T29 kind list — note the same question will recur for slime @24.1, whose stored note calls it '3 ONA eps' while AniList 161802 says OVA.

UNCITABLE KIND (2 of 3) — high-school-dxd @36.5 'Holy Behind the Gymnasium (HERO Episode 0)' (2018-04-10): no source classifies it as ova/special/movie/recap. AniList has NO separate entry; 97767 'High School DxD HERO' is format=TV with episodes=13 and startDate 2018-04-10 — i.e. Episode 0 is counted as part of the TV run and IS the season's first broadcast (https://anilist.co/anime/97767). en-WP 'High School DxD Hero' lists it in the season's TV episode table as season episode 0 / overall 41, aired April 10, 2018 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/High_School_DxD_Hero). ja-WP numbers it 'life.00 体育館裏のホーリー' in the 第4期 episode list and explains 前作後半がオリジナル展開になったこともあり第0話として改めて描かれ、第1話より原作第9巻のストーリーとなる — it re-does BorN's anime-original ending before the season proper starts (https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ハイスクールD×D). So it is a broadcast TV episode numbered 0, not a bonus: it is NOT a recap (it re-animates rather than recaps) and not an OVA/special/movie. Two defensible rulings: (a) keep it order-only and extend T29 with a kind for a numbered-zero broadcast episode, or (b) treat it as a real row and extend the HERO component to 13 rows (37-49), which is what AniList's count implies.

UNCITABLE KIND (3 of 3) — the-heroic-legend-of-arslan @25.2 'Arslan Senki: Fuujin Ranbu': AniList 21424 format=TV, 8 eps, 2016-07-03 to 2016-08-21 (https://anilist.co/anime/21424). This is a TV SEASON, not an order-only bonus, and our own components table already carries it as '21424 [season] 26-33'. The stored note says the same ('Not order-only - this is the missing season 2 component'). No kind assigned; the fix is structural — the order-only entry should be retired now that the season component exists.

PROBABLE DUPLICATE ENTRY — to-love-ru-darkness @24.1 and @24.5 both resolve to the single AniList work 21852 'To LOVE-Ru Darkness 2nd Specials' (format=SPECIAL, 2 eps, 2015-10-29, https://anilist.co/anime/21852): @24.1 names it explicitly ('2nd eps 13-14', chs 43-47) and @24.5 is the untitled '2nd Specials = standalone bonuses; community count = 24' entry from your 2026-08-23 sign-off. Both are typed `special` above so neither is left unresolved, but one of the two positions should almost certainly be dropped. I could not tell from the context which is the keeper — @24.1 carries the chapter detail, @24.5 carries your sign-off.

PROBABLE DUPLICATE ENTRY — yu-yu-hakusho-ghostfiles @112.1 and @112.5 both resolve to AniList 6964 'Yuu Yuu Hakusho Picture Drama' (format=SPECIAL, 1 ep, 6 min, 2009-10-27, https://anilist.co/anime/6964): @112.1 is the batch-14 research-tier entry, @112.5 is the untitled 'Picture Drama = standalone bonus; community count = 112' entry from your 2026-08-23 sign-off. Both typed `special`; one position is redundant.

SHARED ANILIST ID, NOT A DUPLICATE — yu-yu-hakusho-ghostfiles @112.7 'Two Shot' and @112.8 'All or Nothing' are two DIFFERENT 2018 shorts (Two Shot adapts the vol-7 unnumbered bonus chapter; All or Nothing adapts ch 173-174) but AniList indexes them as one entry, 102631 'Yuu☆Yuu☆Hakusho: TWO SHOTS / Noru ka Soru ka' (eps=1, https://anilist.co/anime/102631). Both rows therefore carry the same anilist_id by necessity. Any uniqueness check on (series_id, anilist_id) will false-positive here.

KIND DISAGREEMENT — ghost-in-the-shell-stand-alone-complex @52.5 'Solid State Society': typed `special` (AniList 1566 format=SPECIAL, 108 min, 2006-09-01, and our stored component for 1566 is kind [special]). But en-WP opens 'is a 2006 Japanese anime science fiction television film' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghost_in_the_Shell:_Stand_Alone_Complex_%E2%80%93_Solid_State_Society) and your own stored ruling reasons from the movies rule ('Solid State Society is a FILM — movies are order-only unless community-numbered'). If the kind should match the RATIONALE you applied, this is `movie`; I did not overwrite the stored component kind on my own authority.

KIND DISAGREEMENT — hajime-no-ippo-the-fighting @76.6 'Champion Road': typed `special` (AniList 264 format=SPECIAL, 90 min, 2003-04-18, and our stored component for 264 is kind [special]). en-WP's Hajime no Ippo infobox says type=tv film, network Nippon TV (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hajime_no_Ippo), and the stored watch-order note itself calls it '(TV film)'. `movie` is defensible.

KIND DISAGREEMENT — reborn @203.1: typed `ova` on en-Wikipedia's explicit wording (franchise infobox '203 + 2 OVAs'; 'An original video animation (OVA) was produced ... released in October 2009 during the annual Jump Super Anime Tour'; 'List of Reborn! episodes' == OVAs == table). AniList 8532 says format=ONA (https://anilist.co/anime/8532). ja-WP files it under ジャンプアニメ as an event SCREENING (上映) with a 2010-07-21 complete-edition DVD, which reads closer to `special` than to either. Also: the stored note's 'AniList id not verified' can be cleared — 8532 is confirmed by native title.

KIND DISAGREEMENT — yu-yu-hakusho-ghostfiles @112.7 / @112.8: typed `ova` on en-WP (infobox type=ova, 'Two Shot & All or Nothing', 2 episodes, released October 26, 2018, bundled with the anniversary Blu-ray box). AniList 102631 says format=SPECIAL. The stored notes for both entries already say '(2018 OVA)', so `ova` also matches stored data.

MINOR — that-time-i-got-reincarnated-as-a-slime @24.1 'Visions of Coleus': typed `ova` from AniList 161802 format=OVA (3 eps, 2023-11-01, https://anilist.co/anime/161802). The stored note describes it as '3 ONA eps released 202…'. AniList disagrees with our own note; nothing else contradicts OVA, so OVA is delivered.
